messages:
devon: surprise life update 1 — we had our baby last night (meet claire, 7lbs) and i also got promoted to Staff Engineer today. send coffee and sleep tips 
laura: wowww congratulations!!! both at once? the universe is generous and chaotic. share a pic when you're up for it 60d
pete: incredible news devon. official celebration required. i9c can bring pastries to the team tomorrow. also sorry about the sleep 
rina: huge congrats!! tagging people-ops so we can make sure parental leave & benefits are updated. :baby_bottle:
people-ops-bot: automated reminder: submit parental leave request at https://redwood.internal/hr/leave and update your profile. congrats from People Ops!
emma: i will drop a casserole at your place wednesday night. also i9c have a list of excellent baby carriers if you want recs.
devon: y'all are the best. planning to be mostly offline first week, but i'll peek at pings. thanks for all the offers. really appreciate it <3
laura: also — staff engineer badge unlocked, official confetti when you're back? :confetti_ball:
pete: confetti + terrible dad jokes on the meet-the-baby call if you want. totally optional, of course.
rina: added a short note to the internal announcements template if you want us to post a shoutout in #general. congrats devon!!!
